scenarios.scenario_abstract: While reducing a multi-climate packing list to one layered wardrobe and one carry-on, [X] pays particular attention to the carrier's own share of the fixed weight allowance because it cannot be reduced by packing fewer duplicate clothes.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在把多气候行李压缩为一套分层衣着和一件随身行李时，[X]会特别留意包具本身占用的固定重量，因为这一部分无法通过少带重复衣物继续削减。
examples: using Very Lightweight when every saved unit must remain available for weather layers
using Lightweight when modest structure is worth a small allowance cost
using Standard Weight only when the carrier replaces separate protective organizers

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a first visit to Jaipur, [X] chooses a day bag for water, documents, sun protection, and small purchases during hot walking-intensive days, making the bag body's own contribution the adjustable part of a largely fixed shoulder load.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 第一次前往斋浦尔时，[X]要为炎热且步行密集的日程选择一只装饮水、证件、防晒用品和少量购物的日用包；这些必需品基本固定，因此包体自重成为肩上负担中最可调整的部分。
examples: using Very Lightweight when the empty carrier should be barely noticeable in heat
using Lightweight when a little structure improves organization
rejecting Standard Weight or Heavy when no added structure earns the all-day burden

scenarios.scenario_abstract: At an R&B stadium concert, [X] keeps a phone and a few essentials in a permitted hands-free bag through hours of stairs, standing, dancing, and dense crowds, deciding whether security hardware makes the otherwise tiny carrier tiring to wear.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在 R&B 体育场演唱会上，[X]把手机和少量必需品装入获准的免手持包，经历数小时爬楼、站立、跳舞和拥挤人群，并判断安全五金是否会让原本很小的包也变得累赘。
examples: using Very Lightweight for an all-evening carrier holding only phone and cards
using Lightweight when secure closures justify a modest increase
rejecting heavier construction that adds no venue-compliant function

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While rotating among flights, snorkeling, hikes, historic stops, and resort evenings, [X] packs a dry bag, daypack, reusable tote, and small evening bag inside or beside the main luggage while limiting how much weight and bulk the extra carriers add in transit.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在航班、浮潜、徒步、历史景点和度假村晚间活动之间切换时，[X]会把防水袋、日用背包、可重复使用托特包和小型晚间用包装入或附在主行李中，同时限制这些额外包具在转场时增加的重量和体积。
examples: using Very Lightweight for a pack-flat tote or evening carrier
using Lightweight for the daypack carried on excursions
accepting Standard Weight for the main case only when it replaces several fragile organizers

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For five days of Italian city walking, [X] keeps a passport, cash, water, and a light layer in one front-worn day bag, making the carrier's recurring burden part of the decision about how much secure structure is worthwhile.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在五天的意大利城市步行中，[X]把护照、现金、饮水和轻薄外层放在一只置于身前的日用包里，因此包自身的持续负担会影响多少安全结构才真正值得。
examples: using Very Lightweight when the bag remains on the body throughout long walking days
using Lightweight when organization and a secure front position justify some structure
using Standard Weight only when protective construction replaces separate cases

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Walking the full Camino Frances alone on a limited budget, [X] chooses one backpack for a tightly reduced kit that still has to be carried for weeks and decides how much harness structure is worth adding to the pack's own recurring burden.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 以有限预算独自走完整条法国之路时，[X]要为已经严格精简、却仍需连续背负数周的装备选择唯一背包，并判断背负系统增加的自重是否值得。
examples: using Very Lightweight when minimizing base weight dominates the month-long route
using Lightweight when a supportive harness repays a modest own-weight cost
rejecting Standard Weight or Heavy when added structure does not improve loaded fit

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After recently starting to commute by public transport, [X] evaluates one named Swissgear laptop backpack with a fixed load of a computer, notebooks, water, chargers, and small items, deciding whether padding, organizer panels, robust hardware, and a trolley sleeve justify the carrier's own contribution to daily shoulder load.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 刚开始乘公共交通通勤后，[X]会评估一款有明确型号的 Swissgear 笔记本电脑背包；在电脑、笔记本、饮水、充电器和小物件负载固定时，要判断衬垫、整理面板、坚固五金和行李箱套带是否值得增加每日肩部负担。
examples: using Lightweight when daily shoulder comfort dominates
using Standard Weight when padding and robust construction materially protect the fixed load
rejecting Heavy when extra structure only duplicates existing organizers

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While assembling a first camera kit for walking between landscape and portrait locations, [X] keeps the camera portable but gradually adds a lens, battery, cleaning cloth, and weather protection. A padded camera bag is judged by how much empty weight and structure it adds before the kit is loaded, and whether that burden actually protects the equipment during repeated stops, lens changes, and long periods on foot.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为需要步行转换风景与人像拍摄点的首套相机器材做准备时，[X]会保持机身便携，但也会逐步加入镜头、电池、清洁布和防天气保护；带缓冲的相机包会先按空包自重和结构增量评估，再检查这份负担是否真能在反复停留、更换镜头和长时间步行中保护器材。
examples: using Lightweight when the compact kit already has fitted protection and the route is mostly on foot
using Standard Weight when padding and dividers materially protect a growing beginner kit
using Heavy only when the carried lenses and harsh field conditions genuinely require a reinforced carrier

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a two-week trip mixing ordinary transit with hiking, [X] compares same-capacity backpacks made from light synthetics with reinforced versions and decides whether the expected conditions justify the extra empty weight of reinforced panels, a frame, harness, and hip belt.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一场结合普通交通与徒步的两周旅行中，[X]会比较容量相同的轻质合成面料背包和加固版本，判断实际路况是否值得为加强面板、框架、背负系统和腰带承担更多空包重量。
examples: using Very Lightweight or Lightweight when ordinary travel dominates
using Standard Weight when a substantial harness improves load transfer on trail days
using Heavy only when a stable frame and reinforced protection are genuinely required for harsh sections

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before a two-week international trip, [X] compares twenty-four-inch hard-shell suitcases and checks empty-case weight because the protective shell, telescoping handle, dividers, wheels, and lock consume allowance before clothes are packed.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在两周国际旅行前，[X]会比较 24 英寸硬壳行李箱并专门检查空箱重量，因为保护壳、伸缩拉杆、分隔层、轮子和锁会在装入衣物前先占用托运行李额度。
examples: using Lightweight when the empty case must preserve more airline allowance
using Standard Weight when shell and hardware provide protection the trip genuinely needs
rejecting Heavy when added organizer or lock weight duplicates separate accessories

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: An elite freediver flying from Sharm El Sheikh to a Bahamas depth-training base allocates airline allowance between a reinforced long-fin carrier and a smaller daily training bag, accepting additional empty weight only when it prevents damage to specialized equipment before depth sessions.
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名精英自由潜水者从沙姆沙伊赫飞往巴哈马深度训练基地，需要在加固长脚蹼包和较小的日常训练包之间分配航空重量额度，并且只在能防止专业装备于深潜训练前受损时接受更高空包重量。
